summary: Documentation for `groupNames` is factually incomplete and stylistically inconsistent

items.issue: The description omits that the returned sequence does not include inline group names, which is the core reason for deprecation. The prose does not match the actual behavior (missing inline groups).
items.suggestion: Revise to: "The names of the named capturing groups (excluding inline groups) used to look up groups by name."
